howto: Pick a board (Easy 5x5, Normal 4x4, Hard 3x3) and Classic or the Daily board, then press Play.
Swipe, or press an arrow key, to slide every tile as far as it goes.
Two tiles with the same number merge into one: 2 + 2 makes 4.
Build a 2048 tile (512 on the 3x3 board) before the board fills up.
tips: Keep your biggest tile in one corner and build towards it.
Try not to swipe away from your corner: a stray 2 can get stuck there.
Hint looks two moves ahead and names the swipe that keeps the most space free.
Undo (or the Z key) takes back a move, even from the Game Over card.
Every 12 merges earns a hammer that smashes one tile.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys slide the tiles, Z or U undoes. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe on the board. Undo, Hint, 50/50 and Hammer sit under it.

difficulty: Board size is the difficulty: Easy is 5x5 (lots of room), Normal is the classic 4x4, Hard is 3x3 with a 512 goal.

cheats.effect: Hammer time: three hammers, ready to smash
All fours: every new tile is a 4
Big tile: a 256 drops into an empty square

features.hints: Hint button under the board (and Pause > Hint): a two-move look-ahead names the best swipe and why
features.undo: Undo button, the Z key, and Undo last move on the Game Over card
features.level-select-or-daily: Board size (5x5, 4x4, 3x3) on the title, plus a Daily board where everyone gets the same tiles today
features.results: Game Over card with score, best tile, best combo, 2048 wins, lifetime merges and club tier; a You Win card at the goal tile
